title.hr: Geometrijska tijela: vrhovi, bridovi i plohe

concept.hr: Tijela razlikujemo po plohama, bridovima i vrhovima; okretanje pokaže skrivene
concept.en: Solids are told apart by surfaces, edges and vertices; turning shows hidden ones

summary.hr: Okreći kocku, kvadar, piramidu, valjak, stožac i kuglu, prebroji vrhove, bridove i plohe, rasklopi kocku u mrežu.
summary.en: Turn a cube, cuboid, pyramid, cylinder, cone and sphere, count vertices, edges and faces, unfold a cube into a net.

title.hr: Koliko vrhova ima kocka? Što vidimo, a što je iza
title.en: How many vertices has a cube? Seen and hidden

concept.hr: Vidimo 7 vrhova kocke, osmi je iza: okretanje ga pokaže
concept.en: We see 7 vertices of a cube, the 8th is behind: turning shows it

concept.hr: Bridovi nisu svi jednaki: kocka šećera je kvadar
concept.en: Its edges are not all equal: a sugar “cube” is a cuboid
